Factor influence graph

Written by AI and not fully reviewed. Arrows are proposed influences, not estimated effects.

Grey: factors. Underlined nodes link to their page. Blue: life stages. Yellow: conditional ASFRs. Red: TFR and its consequences. Feedback from low TFR (through population ageing and the low-fertility trap) back to policy and preferences is left off to keep the layout readable.
